summary: Phase 2 (Windows installer / docs / downloads / setup / network / collapsible sidebar) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 18/18 pass in /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_installer.py: (a) GET /api/setup/status returns {needs_setup:false}; (b) POST /api/setup/complete → 409 with 'ya se completó'; (c) GET /api/system/network returns {port:null, lan:[...list], tailscale_ips:[], tailscale_name:null, hostname:'<non-empty>', can_shutdown:false}; (d) POST /api/system/shutdown → 400 in preview; (e) GET /api/downloads lists manual.pdf, guia-casa.pdf, guia-centro.pdf, problemas.pdf plus OriSetup.exe, each with int size>0; (f) GET /api/downloads/<name>?token=… returns application/pdf with %PDF header for all 4 PDFs (bearer header path also validated); (g) path traversal ..%2Fsecret, ..%2F..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd, hidden .foo and nonexistent names all → 404; (h) /docs/<slug>.md statically served (len>10) for all four slugs. Frontend playwright: Nav items nav-help and nav-downloads visible at 1366x768 (scrollW=1366==clientW, no overflow) and 1536x780 (scrollW==clientW==1060). HelpPage: all 4 tabs render, help-content holds 6339 chars + 8 images for 'manual'; switching to guia-casa yields distinct content (2419 chars). help-pdf-download href = /api/downloads/<slug>.pdf?token=…. DownloadsPage: items download-item-OriSetup.exe (first, teal border highlight), -guia-casa.pdf, -guia-centro.pdf, -manual.pdf, -problemas.pdf render; each download-link-<name> href = /api/downloads/<encoded>?token=…. Settings network card (preview, no ORI_PORT): settings-online-address shows the preview origin; settings-downloads-link=/descargas, settings-help-link=/ayuda; settings-shutdown-button absent (can_shutdown=false). SetupWizard via page.route interception of /api/setup/status→{needs_setup:true}: wizard mounts, setup-code-input accepts text, setup-next-1 enables ≥6 chars and advances; step 2 shows setup-gemini-input, setup-gemini-link href=https://aistudio.google.com/apikey, and setup-back returns to step 1. setup-finish NOT clicked (per instructions). Collapsible sidebar (profile Paula, conv 6ac6c7901677bf873bdca0d6): initial data-collapsed=false, width=288, chat area=1078; after sidebar-collapse-button click → data-collapsed=true, width=56, chat area=1310 (grew). Rail items sidebar-expand-button, sidebar-rail-new, sidebar-rail-search all present. localStorage['ori.sidebar.6ac681af4c6b10bd64f5d546']='1' after collapse; survives reload (data-collapsed=true). Ctrl+B toggles both directions (true→false→true). sidebar-rail-search click: expands sidebar AND focuses conversation-search-input (document.activeElement===el). Small screen 900x700: starts collapsed; clicking sidebar-expand-button renders sidebar-backdrop overlay; clicking backdrop re-collapses it. Regression: chat page renders, 7 inline-cite chips present, clicking first opens doc-side-panel, doc-side-close closes it cleanly. No conversations/documents modified.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_setup._downloads_dir() will raise KeyError if DOWNLOADS_DIR env var is missing (os.environ[...] vs .get). Backend .env has it set, but the module would 500 instead of returning an empty list. Prefer os.environ.get('DOWNLOADS_DIR', '/app/downloads') or guard with a 503.

routes_setup.get_download: path traversal check happens AFTER constructing `p = _downloads_dir() / name`. Although returns 404 before touching disk, it's safer to resolve/validate first. Current behavior is correct (slash/backslash rejected, is_file() prevents escape) and passes tests, but a Path.resolve().is_relative_to(downloads_dir) check would be more defensive.
SetupWizard step 2 uses setup-gemini-input of type=password without an aria-label; a visible <Field label=…> wrapper exists so it's acceptable, but screen-reader hint would be nicer. Non-blocking.

DownloadsPage: info.icon fallback branches to FileText only when not in INFO. Unknown file names in the future will show FileText but keep the file.name as title — fine. Note size formatting uses 1e3/1e6/1e9 (SI) which may confuse users expecting KiB/MiB — minor.

ConversationSidebar useSidebarState persists only '1' for collapsed, not an object; the key is scoped per profile correctly. Small-screen heuristic re-runs on resize so switching between desktop and mobile layouts preserves state as expected.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-2 is green. OriSetup.exe (1.14 GB) is present in /app/downloads and is listed first with the teal highlight border on DownloadsPage. The 404 path-traversal test uses URL-encoded slashes (..%2Fsecret) — unencoded '../' would be collapsed by Starlette's router before reaching the handler, so the test as written validates the handler's own guard. /docs/<slug>.md is served by the frontend static layer (not /api) and was validated at the public origin. The collapsible sidebar's localStorage key is 'ori.sidebar.<profileId>' with value '1' for collapsed and '' (or missing) for expanded; the small-screen auto-collapse kicks in at viewport width < 1024px. For future retests of the real setup flow, set backend env ORI_SETUP_WIZARD=1 and clear the Mongo settings doc _id='setup' — the preview intentionally has needs_setup=false so complete returns 409.
